notes: S2-FIX1 Q5 (F68 open point; §5.5.2): grant/chain-depth-9-links (a note citing the depth-9 grant, nine parent links, one beyond the bound) where the root grant is not transferable, so the ninth link (grant-depth-1 to the root, beyond the depth bound for the note) fails step 3. Steps 1-5 are walked beyond the bound as well, and step 1 requires each resolved parent to be a valid record: grant-depth-1 is itself invalid (E_GRANT_NOT_TRANSFERABLE). Expectation changed by S2-FIX2 U2 (decision 2026-11-15 #22; Q6, step 1 in two tiers): a parent that is present but itself invalid makes its child invalid E_GRANT_GRANTER, so every grant above grant-depth-1 and the note are invalid E_GRANT_GRANTER. A failure beyond the bound is never hidden behind step 7, and the invalid outcome reaches the note (S2-FIX1 had E_GRANT_UNRESOLVED).
